$comment: Pinned upstream resources (IMPLEMENTATION.md §3, §8.2; verified in task 0.3, see docs/deps-verification.md). Keys are the resource folder names as ensured in server.cfg. scripts/fetch-deps.mjs clones repo@commit into resources/[upstream]/<key> (mode REFERENCE is skipped). 'tag' + 'release' are set where the upstream's documented install path is a release zip (built web UI / dist not in git): the commit is the tag's commit and the server must run the release zip of that tag, the git checkout only serves patches and review. Never track 'latest'; bump commit (+tag/release) and re-run fetch-deps + apply-patches.

oxmysql.notes: Release zip is the documented install (README, Qbox txAdmin recipe); git has no built dist/. HEAD 030d3bd (2026-07-03) is 21 commits ahead, incl. a TINY/BIT typecast change (887d841). DATETIME -> epoch ms parsed in the FXServer host's local zone (src/utils/typeCast.ts:30-39), TINYINT(1) -> boolean.

ox_lib.notes: Release zip is the documented install (web/build not in git). overextended chosen over CommunityOx: every CommunityOx HEAD is an ancestor of overextended HEAD. HEAD b8f5a04 (2026-09-04) is 8 commits ahead incl. 'refactor(require): support ox_lib modules v2' - not pinned.

ox_inventory.notes: Release zip is the documented install (web/build not in git). PATCH = data/items.lua entries (pd_tablet, pd_ram, evidences items). The Qbox txAdmin recipe overwrites data/items.lua with Qbox's own list, so a patch made against upstream will not apply to a recipe-installed server (open question in docs/deps-verification.md).

ox_target.notes: Release zip is the documented install (README, recipe). HEAD bf03d52 only changes README.md. evidences only recommends (does not require) the noobsystems ox_target fork.

ox_doorlock.notes: README: 'The UI needs to be built - use the latest release'. createDoor/removeDoor exports exist only after the tag (HEAD 4e56b7e); getDoor, getAllDoors, getDoorFromName, setDoorState, registerHook are in v1.22.1.

qbx_core.notes: HEAD of main; the Qbox txAdmin recipe installs main (download_github ref main). Latest tag v1.24.0 (c1c3ca1, 2026-08-22) is 16 commits behind. Rami's server already runs qbx_core: this pin is the version FredPD was verified against, not something to overwrite blindly.

qbx_policejob.notes: Folder name from fxmanifest name/README title 'qbx_policejob'. The Qbox txAdmin recipe clones it to resources/[qbx]/qbx_police (resource name = folder name): server.cfg and the prison adapter must use whichever folder Rami's server has. No release tags; LICENSE is bare GPLv3 text (no or-later notice). Patch targets: server/main.lua IsLeoAndOnDuty (13-18), evidence:server:* (435-557), FlaggedPlateTriggered (345-362).

qbx_prison.notes: Exists; exports JailPlayer(src, minutes) / ReleasePlayer(src). Effectively unmaintained: last functional commit 2024-06-23, the 2026 commit is repo-template chore. The current Qbox txAdmin recipe ships xt-prison instead (qbx_police has xt-prison compat). Use only if Rami's server runs it (docs/deps-verification.md Decisions).

qbx_vehicles.notes: HEAD of main (recipe installs main; tag v1.4.2 is 6 commits behind). Server event qbx_vehicles:server:vehicleSaved(vehicleId); hooks via exports.qbx_vehicles:registerHook('createPlayerVehicle'|'changeVehicleOwner', fn). Required by qbx_garages.

qbx_garages.notes: HEAD of main (recipe installs main; tag v1.1.4 is 20 commits behind). exports.qbx_garages:registerHook('parkVehicle'|'spawnVehicle'|'spawnedVehicle', fn) covers task 3.4 without a patch.

evidences.notes: Tag v1.3.1 = HEAD of main. Release zip is the documented install (html/dui/laptop/dist is built, not in git); item images: releases/download/v1.3.1/item_images.zip; items from .github/setup/en_items.lua go into ox_inventory data/items.lua. No sv locale upstream. Works with upstream ox_target (the noobsystems fork is only recommended).

ps-dispatch.notes: HEAD of main = tag 3.0.0 (8de73dd) + a README-only commit; no release zip (html/ is committed). Qbox support is through qbx_core's qb-core bridge. fxmanifest hard-includes @PolyZone files that the code never uses (lib.zones): install PolyZone or patch those 3 lines. lsn-radar is not referenced by any code (optional). Patch: TriggerEvent('fredpd:alertCreated', data) in server/main.lua before broadcastCall (line 335) and a broadcast/keybind switch (no NUI-off config flag exists).

screenshot-basic.notes: Only commit on master since 2022; git clone is the documented install and FXServer builds dist/ at start through the cfx-server-data yarn + webpack builder resources. Current Qbox recipe servers run itschip/screencapture (AGPL-3.0, provide 'screenshot-basic', same requestScreenshotUpload signature) instead: never run both.

bub-mdt.notes: Reference only (not fetched, never started): web/src/utils/fetchNui.ts, debugData.ts, server/ SQL shapes. No commits in 2026. Copied code keeps its GPL header.
